title: Pizza Connection 3 / Barro's Pizza exclusive project scope

prohibited.rule: Do not inspect, edit, generate for, reverse engineer, migrate, test, package, document as active work, or continue tasks for PC2/Fast Food Tycoon 2 under this program. Do not reuse PC2 assets, formats, catalogs, counts, tools, plans, contracts, evidence, or assumptions as PC3 truth.

documentation_policy.active_pc3_docs: must state Scope: PC3 ONLY or live beneath a repository with the root PC3-only marker
documentation_policy.retained_pc2_archive_docs: must state Scope: PC2 ONLY and must not live in an active PC3 repository

agent_behavior.on_pc2_request_or_context: STOP that task, mark it out_of_scope, do not mutate PC2 files, and redirect work to the corresponding PC3 or PC3 Pizza Creator target.
agent_behavior.on_ambiguous_game_target: Fail closed and report target ambiguity until the repository/runtime profile proves PC3.
agent_behavior.cross_project_rule: Workbench, Runtime Proof Studio, Barro's Pizza Creator, pizza-agent, Windows-MCP tasks, GitHub/GitLab publication, Unity work, image generation and runtime proof are all PC3-only.

truth_rule: PC2 evidence can never satisfy a PC3 gate. Only evidence from the exact PC3 runtime profile named by the relevant contract is admissible.
